name: Connecticut Hypodermics Inc
old_description: We are the leading manufacturer of precision custom hypodermic needles and other related components for medical devices. Connecticut Hypodermics' skilled engineering staff continually develops innovative manufacturing solutions to produce products in the most efficient manner, and we've done it, year after year, with the most consistent, reliable and cost-effective results possible.
about:
Connecticut Hypodermics Inc. was founded in 1979 and is based in Wallingford, Connecticut, with its facility located in the Yalesville area. The company has operated continuously since its inception, building a reputation for precision needle manufacturing.

The company specializes in precision custom hypodermic needles and related components for medical devices. Its capabilities span a wide range of fabrication and assembly processes, including automatic and manual assembly, mechanical crimping, ring staking, epoxy bonding, bending, centerless grinding, cleaning and passivation, EDM machining, electrolytic cutting, laser marking, swaging, tube forming, welding, and more. The engineering staff develops custom manufacturing solutions to produce parts efficiently at varying volumes.

Connecticut Hypodermics serves the medical device industry, supplying original equipment manufacturers and component suppliers who require high-precision needle products. The company’s customer base includes firms developing surgical instruments, diagnostic equipment, and other healthcare technologies that demand tight tolerances and biocompatible materials.

The firm differentiates itself through a commitment to meeting challenging customer requirements with innovative manufacturing approaches. It emphasizes consistent, reliable, and cost-effective results, backed by ISO 13485:2016 certification and a focus on quality precision across all operations.
